items.reason: two reasoning tiers disagree about where the loss lands; deduplicator declines to adjudicate
items.summary: Cross-stream FoT/rebasing contamination via Uniboost's unrestricted primeToken_. Pattern tier: NudgeStreamer holds all streams in ONE token balance and credits buffer += amount with no balance-delta check, so the sum(buffers) == held-balance invariant breaks and one stream's _settle could draw down another's backing. Code tier: _accrued caps at buffer, so the shortfall lands on the LAST claimant of that pair only. Both agree there is no exploit at the live USDC topology. Generic FoT remains permanently C4-invalid on this project family; the cross-stream SHARED-BALANCE solvency claim is a different claim and is why this was routed rather than auto-suppressed.
items.askOfHuman: Decide whether the shared-balance solvency claim needs its own entry, or whether the constructor guard recommended in DEDUP-19-09 closes it.

C4's 'root cause OOS in parent/forked contracts' would normally exclude it. items.reason: LEDGER-INTEGRITY ALERT — a closed entry whose closure basis no longer holds
items.summary: Ledger entry L-08 (fingerprint 0b97f155...) is status `fixed` (fixedAtCommit 7b86decc, story-038, recheckResult LIKELY-FIXED). Its fix was a full-balance sweep inside NudgeRatchet._dispatch, and the closure was explicitly judged 'on whether out-of-band USDC becomes recoverable, NOT on literal rescueERC20 presence'. Story-046 made that sweep's only delivery leg an external cross-repo call that can revert, so the recoverability property the closure rested on no longer holds. This is an EXPIRED CLOSURE — the patch is INTACT at d4cc563 (verified in source at src/dispatchers/NudgeRatchet.sol:142-162); it is neither a regression nor an incomplete fix, and reviewers must not be sent to restore a sweep that is already there. Tier-3 test_T2c independently proves the funds are unreachable today (owner rescueERC20 selector absent, positive control on a sibling returns true, the only forwarding path is itself reverting).
items.askOfHuman: Apply (or decline) an L-08 reopen via /ledger. Status changes are human-applied only. Do not let finding-manager clobber the existing fixNote — append, do not overwrite.
items.resolution: ADJUDICATED 2026-07-25 — REOPEN DECLINED and the expired-closure basis REFUTED. The alert's premise was that story-046 destroyed the recoverability the closure rested on. It did not: NFTMinterV2._executeMint does the user's safeTransferFrom and dispatch() in ONE transaction (src/NFTMinterV2.sol:181-190), so a reverting streamer leg reverts the payment with it and NO user payment can ever be resident on NudgeRatchet; and collectNudge:149 pulls the exact approved amount, so a successful dispatch leaves no remainder. The only residency path is out-of-band strays — exactly what L-08 described at Low — and they are swept as soon as the owner cures the registration. test_T2c is sound but its 500 USDC is placed by the harness, i.e. the out-of-band path; it does not show that mint-derived value can sit there. L-08 stays `fixed`, fixNote untouched, run19Decision appended (not overwritten). The wedge half was NOT erased: it lives on as ledger L-16 (b0aa0f58…, QA L-01, open), which absorbed the withdrawn M-02; the reserved fingerprint 03864c76 was NOT minted. See reports/yield-claim-nft/19/submissions/M-02.md.
